name: Full-Time
description: Standard regular employment with full working hours per week (typically 35-40 hours) with standard benefits.

name: Part-Time
description: Regular employment with fewer hours per week than full-time, offering flexible schedules and prorated perks.

name: Contract / Freelance
description: Project-based or fixed-term engagement governed by a service level agreement, without standard corporate benefits.

name: Internship
description: Fixed-term educational or practical training position designed for students or recent graduates to gain industry exposure.

name: Seasonal
description: Temporary employment tied to specific peak operational periods, cyclical demands, or holiday surges.

name: Apprenticeship
description: Structured long-term program combining on-the-job vocational training with technical classroom instruction.

name: Commission-Only
description: Performance-linked role where payment is fully derived from sales conversions or transactions, without a fixed base salary.

name: Vendor / Third-Party
description: Outsourced role where the professional remains an employee of an external agency or consulting vendor partner.

name: Volunteer / Unpaid
description: Altruistic, non-compensated regular or project role aligned with non-profit, charity, or grassroots initiatives.

name: Casual / On-Call
description: Intermittent employment with no guaranteed or predictable weekly hours, called in as operational volumes demand.
